translations.reason: Original adaptive query-file working-set controller for standard BLAST CLI batching
translations.adaptations: Private typed fields and inherent snake_case methods preserve source constants,int/f64 operation order,EMA and if/else clamp/reset history. Constructor maps to CBatchSizeMixer::c_batch_size_mixer; default C++ hits argument represented explicitly as-1. Define out-of-range/nonfinite quotient conversion as INT_MIN, matching actual pinned x86 cvttsd2si oracle before original lower clamp. Source C++ cast is undefined outside i32 range; this explicit safe portable policy does not claim matching every upstream compiler/architecture. Rust saturating cast would otherwise select maximum rather than minimum batch for hits0. No unsafe,new dependency,allocator,source algorithm replacement or CLI edit.

Target,batch and ratio f64 bits all match debug and optimized Rust. integration_notes: Expose mod query_batch_size when wiring CLI; public library explicit PreparedBatch need not acquire hidden batching. This worker changed only new src/query_batch_size.rs and pending metadata.

Source nucleotide CLI maximum batch is SplitQuery_GetChunkSize(program)-1000; initial target SetTargetHits(database_total_length/3000),with at least1m through source setter; use previous batch GetNumExtensions feedback, and input batches can exceed requested letters when last whole query crosses threshold. Wrapper/input reading and per-query result renumbering remain parent/adapter integration scope.
No changes to original source statistics or split thresholds; this is the missing source working-set controller, not a custom arena proposal.

Exposed as a library utility for explicit caller batching. The core PreparedBatch search API keeps its explicit batch semantics; the validation example currently uses one prepared batch, with source internal query splitting. No automatic CLI batching or performance claim is made.
